label: Cogito thinking-root and same-witness essence nodes against actual root existence
summary: Curation pass 2 of #2103 (lane E). The Cogito route's necessary thinking root b401eca0 (producer 60df7e87, consuming the thinker-local premises db72222b and debcd4e1 with producers 601022e8 and 9e38fb0b) had no consumer reaching the root. Result b8b4e9f5 (actualRootOfThinkingRoot, specs/cogito-actual-root.toml) keeps the rootness clause of b401eca0 and gives the root-path input dc397705 (ActualRootExistsAt) at the same profile and world. It is a declared assembly transcription (invariant 16): the proof repackages the premise's witness and rootness clause. It carries closure only by rule (d), through b401eca0, which is closed as the conclusion of the non-transcription result 60df7e87 with open premises. The placements of 60df7e87, 601022e8 and 9e38fb0b rest on that rule (d) closure alone, and none of their premises is established. Rejected in the same pass: the analogous projection from the same-witness essence node 63bd518f. That statement links two senses each of NECESSARY (NECESSARY_11 and NECESSARY_2), CAUSE_OF_ESSE_VERSUS_SUFFICIENT_REASON, WORLD_RELATIVE_EXISTENCE_METAPHYSICAL_ESSE_NECESSITY and WELL_FOUNDEDNESS_AND_ANTI_BRUTE_ROOT. The projection would need four premise-carried sense bridges for clauses the proof discards, and one of them, CAUSE_OF_ESSE_VERSUS_SUFFICIENT_REASON_1, has no distinct Lean declaration, so a bridge to it cannot be bind-checked. The frame sense NECESSARY_11 is not the reason: result dedd529a (PR #2156) registers NECESSARY_3 to NECESSARY_11 as a premise-carried bridge on 32a2f51c, the same legacy pattern, kept there because that statement itself reads the tertia via's possibility as the frame's diamond.
blocker: 63bd518f and its producers 9d77f415 and 2302a4ef stay unplaced. A consumer would need a root-path statement that uses its essence-esse identity on the same witness (for example the no-limiting-principle root 6c37be2d, which also needs noncomposition and firstness), or a per-sense split of 63bd518f.
